title: Stata reusable-block quality and generality rubric
purpose: labeled checkpoint의 기존 source-span 기반 generality 판정을 일관되게 검토하고, generation default 후보를 고르는 정적 심사표이다. 낮은 점수의 근거까지 삭제하는 필터가 아니며 reference/negative evidence로 보존한다. 연구 설계·추정량의 실질적 타당성 또는 Stata 실행 성공을 판정하지 않는다.

required_inputs: target workflow contract when selecting a variant

source_evidence.section: Hands-off running: Creating a controller script
merge — Merge datasets, pp. 3-9 (assert(), keep(), key variables)
supports: distinguish filtering keep() from verification assert()

source_evidence.section: Do identifier and time uniquely identify the data?
Why does my merge produce a dataset with too many observations?
supports: duplicate IDs can silently expand a match merge

source_evidence.section: macro — Macro definition and manipulation, p. 307
supports: local macros are scoped to a do-file/program
record a seed/state when sort randomness matters
a do-file is a script for a fixed task, input, and output
an ado command is appropriate when a reusable task accepts arguments and produces results
a do-file should reproduce reported results and outputs
reproducibility requires executable analysis code rather than undocumented interactive steps

hard_fail_rules.when: annotation.decision is drop or annotation.reuse_scope is negative
hard_fail_rules.reason: comparison/anti-pattern evidence must never become generated code

hard_fail_rules.when: label_id, source_path, source_spans, source_file_sha256, or code_sha256 is absent or does not verify
hard_fail_rules.reason: a reusable template must retain an auditable source unit

hard_fail_rules.when: target state fails annotation.selection_conditions or state_signature.requires
hard_fail_rules.reason: a high-scoring block cannot override its state contract

hard_fail_rules.when: adaptation_mode is minimal_substitution but minimal_edit_fields metadata is absent, or a requested change is outside minimal_edit_fields and required_changes; an explicitly present empty list means exact reuse with no edits allowed
hard_fail_rules.reason: the block would otherwise be copied as an unbounded rewrite

hard_fail_rules.when: an absolute personal/user/cloud path, author-only credential, or unparameterized local drive path is required for a general default
hard_fail_rules.reason: external replication guidance advises dynamically deriving the root rather than hard-coding a project path

hard_fail_rules.when: a merge/join changes retained observations but cardinality and allowed match states are neither declared by merge options nor checked in adjacent context, and the annotation has no bounded required_change that must add those exact checks before reuse
hard_fail_rules.reason: key/cardinality and unexpected match states are un-auditable; a bounded mandatory repair may retain the block as conditional but never preferred until applied

hard_fail_rules.when: max_loop_depth >= 3 in authored executable code, or max_loop_depth == 2 without two plain repeated axes, substantial code reduction, and visible research/output choices
hard_fail_rules.reason: plugin generation policy: two-level control flow is a narrow readability exception, while deeper or opaque multidimensional control flow is ineligible; this is not a claim that Stata syntax forbids nesting

hard_fail_rules.when: program define contains estimation, sample restriction, merge, or treatment logic without an explicit contract and direct call-site visibility
hard_fail_rules.reason: valid Stata programming can still hide research choices from a template reviewer; Stata's own script/command distinction supports reserving argument-driven commands for genuinely reusable tasks

scoring.formula: round(100 * sum(weight * score / 5 for applicable dimensions) / sum(weight for applicable dimensions), 1)
scoring.applicability_rule: merge_key_integrity applies only to merge/join/append/reshape or panel-key blocks; sample_estimand_visibility applies to sample, treatment, estimation, post-estimation, descriptives, robustness, and figure/export blocks. All other dimensions apply. Inapplicable dimensions are excluded and the denominator is renormalized; a relevant but missing control scores 0.

dimensions.question: 실행 전후 데이터 상태, active estimate, macro/seed/preserve-restore 의존성이 source span 또는 바로 인접 문맥에서 보이는가?
dimensions.score_5: requires/produces와 state-changing commands가 명시되고 숨은 session state가 없다
dimensions.score_3: 주 상태는 보이나 global/current-estimate 의존을 문맥에서 추론해야 한다
dimensions.score_0: 필수 상태가 보이지 않거나 이전 interactive state에 의존한다

dimensions.question: 입력 파일·키·변수와 생성/저장되는 dataset, estimate, table, figure의 역할이 명시되는가?
dimensions.score_3: 명령은 있으나 role 또는 overwrite semantics가 불완전하다

dimensions.question: 다른 OS·사용자·project root에서 최소 설정으로 실행 가능한가?
dimensions.score_5: 동적 root와 상대/파생 경로, 필요한 mkdir가 있다
dimensions.score_3: 한 개의 명시적 root placeholder만 바꾸면 된다
dimensions.score_0: username, personal cloud path, drive letter 또는 machine-specific binary가 분석 코드에 박혀 있다

dimensions.question: 한 reviewer가 변수 변환, 사양, 저장효과를 linearly 읽을 수 있는가?
dimensions.score_5: 짧고 직접적이며 의미 있는 명령 순서와 주석/labels가 있다
dimensions.score_3: 읽을 수 있으나 긴 varlist, macro expansion 또는 분기 추적이 필요하다
dimensions.score_0: 많은 hidden macro, delimiter 변경, 복잡한 side effect가 핵심 논리를 가린다

dimensions.question: cardinality, key uniqueness, retained match states, observation loss가 검증되는가?
dimensions.score_5: 사전 isid/duplicates 또는 명시 cardinality, merge assert()/immediate _merge assertion, 이후 key/row check가 있다
dimensions.score_3: cardinality 또는 retained state 중 하나만 명시한다

dimensions.question: outcome, treatment/comparison, sample rule, estimator, FE/cluster/weights와 e(sample) handoff가 필요한 곳에서 직접 보이는가?
dimensions.score_5: 모든 해당 요소와 output-link가 nearby code/contract에 명시된다
dimensions.score_3: 주요 사양은 보이나 sample/filter 또는 output estimate handoff가 불분명하다

dimensions.question: 반복/프로그램이 반복축을 분명히 줄이고 연구 논리를 숨기지 않는가?
dimensions.score_5: 한 단계 loop이거나, 같은 기계적 본문을 두 plain 반복축에 적용해 중복을 크게 줄이면서 모든 연구·출력 선택이 보이는 검토된 2중 loop이다; program이면 인자를 받는 범용 기계 작업과 좁은 입출력 계약이 있다
dimensions.score_3: 유용하나 macro/program call graph를 따라가야 한다
dimensions.score_0: 깊이 3 이상 loop, 불투명한 2중 loop, broad adapter, 또는 research-choice hiding program이 있다

dimensions.question: hands-off rerun, logging, deterministic random/sort behavior, durable outputs을 지원하는가?
dimensions.score_5: master/log/output and relevant seed/state are explicit
dimensions.score_3: 재실행은 가능하나 log, seed, output replacement 중 일부가 빠진다
dimensions.score_0: interactive selection/manual transfer 또는 non-deterministic step이 필수다

dimensions.question: 교체 가능한 variable/key/file/schema binding을 제외하고도 author-only helper, undocumented sentinel, scattered global state, bespoke control flow 또는 one-off assembly에 얼마나 결박되는가? (높을수록 결박이 낮음)
dimensions.score_5: variable/key/file/schema 이름은 선언된 binding으로 고립되고 알고리즘·상태전이는 범용이다
dimensions.score_3: 여러 schema binding이 있지만 위치와 의미가 명시되어 좁은 human review로 바꿀 수 있다
dimensions.score_0: undocumented sentinel, author helper/global, project-specific research choice 또는 bespoke multi-file control flow가 작동에 필수다

dimensions.question: minimal_edit_fields와 required_changes 안에서 source block의 제어흐름·명령 순서를 보존하며 쓸 수 있는가?
dimensions.score_5: variable/key/path 등 예상 binding이 좁게 고립되고 target binding이 명확하다
dimensions.score_3: 여러 구조 binding의 human review가 필요하지만 제어흐름은 보존된다
dimensions.score_0: 변경 범위가 block algorithm/control flow 또는 여러 파일의 coordinated rewrite까지 확대된다

score_bands.meaning: hard fail 없음; state contract가 맞으면 checkpoint 내 우선 후보
명시된 method/target contract, bounded required changes, provenance check와 human review가 모두 있을 때만 사용; atomic span의 package-level context 부재만으로 필수 workflow 단계를 비우지 않도록 adjudicated coverage에 맞춰 보정
낮은 점수도 출처가 유효하면 설명·비교·gap 진단용으로 보존하며 default generation에는 사용하지 않음; exclude는 점수 cutoff가 아니라 negative/drop 또는 실제 hard fail에만 적용

tie_break: exact selection_conditions and input/output contract match
explicit_canonical_exception only when the user expressly requests that canonical contract
reuse_scope priority: general > method_specific > project_specific; negative is ineligible
higher minimal_adaptation, then lower project_specific_coupling burden
shorter verified source span only if the above tie; finally lexical label_id for determinism
prohibitions: Do not select a preferred score over a state-contract match.
Do not average or splice variants.
Do not convert a project_specific block into a general default merely because it is readable.

Do not classify a block as project_specific merely because its variable names, key names, file names, or required data shape are concrete; judge whether those bindings are isolated from the reusable algorithm.
Do not delete low-scoring evidence; retain it as reference_only or negative unless provenance is invalid.
Do not infer causal validity from this rubric score.

For event-study figures, require fixed range and ticks only for a declared axis_group of directly compared, closely related outcomes; otherwise use automatic axes, keep sheet_group independent, and do not encode a dispatcher for axis settings.

application_protocol: Read the raw source span and at least two meaningful adjacent commands on both sides; verify file and span hashes before scoring.

Populate source_specific_elements from literals, schema assumptions, helper/program prerequisites, special sentinels, and path/output conventions actually observed. Separate expected_binding from harmful_coupling.
Set applicability from checkpoint/stage and command anchors, then score each applicable dimension independently; do not use a clean style score to compensate for missing merge or estimand evidence.
Record policy hard fails separately from external-source findings. A hard fail means generation ineligibility, not that Stata syntax is invalid.

If a safety defect is covered by a narrow, testable required_change and the provenance checker requires an attestation that it was applied, retain the block as conditional/reference and make it ineligible for preferred exact reuse; do not manufacture a hard fail.

When selecting for a user project, re-run compatibility and minimal-adaptation checks against that project's observed interface. Do not change existing names/call order merely to fit a high-scoring example.

Treat an explicitly present empty minimal_edit_fields list as an exact-copy contract: no substitution is permitted. Fail only when the field is absent or an edit exceeds the declared fields/required changes.
Use score bands to control default generation, not to erase the corpus. When uncertain, retain the block as reference_only with the uncertainty recorded rather than manufacturing a hard fail.
uncertainty: Static review cannot prove data semantics, merge correctness, or estimand validity; runtime/data audit remains required.

An absent command in a small atomic span may be supplied by its declared input/output contract, package/root context, or immediate context; reviewers must mark that evidence rather than assume absence.

Concrete variable names and data shapes are expected research bindings. They become harmful coupling only when they cannot be changed within declared edit fields while preserving control flow and the state contract.

Official sources support mechanics and reproducibility practices. Numeric weights, 85/55 bands, loop-depth guard, and minimal-adaptation contract are plugin policy choices calibrated against adjudicated atomic-block coverage. A low score alone does not erase a provenance-valid block.
